items.source:
System property that instructs Spring to ignore Objenesis, not even attempting
to use it. Setting this flag to "true" is equivalent to letting Spring find
out that Objenesis isn't working at runtime, triggering the fallback code path
immediately: Most importantly, this means that all CGLIB AOP proxies will be
created through regular instantiation via a default constructor.
items.translation: 指示 Spring 忽略 Objenesis（甚至不尝试使用它）的系统属性。将此标志设置为 "true" 等同于让 Spring 在运行时发现 Objenesis 无法工作，从而立即触发回退代码路径：最重要的是，这意味着所有 CGLIB AOP 代理都将通过默认构造函数进行常规实例化来创建。

items.source: useCache - whether to use the instantiator cache (typically true but can be set to false for example, for reloadable classes)
items.translation: useCache - 是否使用实例化缓存（通常为 true，但可设置为 false，例如用于可重新加载的类）
